capture.summary: User questions on cutscene vs event triggers, missing spells/runes/stats in hub, spaceVectors rationale, and per-pack icons.

followups.item: Cutscenes today use triggerKind (item_tag, skill_unlock, escape, room_entry_feature, …) on cutscene records; eventPack uses metric/kind triggers. Decide whether to unify authoring (e.g. events reference cutsceneId) or document the two-track model in GAMEPLAY-DESIGN / content pipeline.
spaceVectors remains for unified space model + ingest patches (docs-site content-pack-ingest). Schedule deprecation only when balance/sim consumers no longer read packs.spaceVectors.
content_spells.json has no visual URLs yet; review hub uses Lucide Wand2 for the pack row until sprites are added to spell definitions.

done-in-repo.item: Bundler now includes spellPack, runePack, gameStats, combatStatPack.
Explorer sidebar uses distinct Lucide icons per pack (quests/items/skills/spells/run…).
META descriptions clarify cutscenes vs events and why spaceVectors exists.
